items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I took a few lessons from Big Eye Louie.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think Albert Nicholas, no, three or four. Even Big Eye Louie, I believe, took some lessons from Papa, Teo. Yeah. I think Big Eye taught him.
I took a few lessons from Big Eye Louie.
Well, you took some from him too. Yeah. I understand he never did use music so much, he had a wonderful ear. Did he teach you how to book though too, or just?
